entries.00794c770db646ba: This is one of the categories of the logistics business, handling sea cargo. Handled volume for the fiscal year ended March 2026 remained firm.
entries.014e06c4ee9becaf: Real Estate Leasing, Management and Sales
entries.09bcfabd10e63ff4: This business consists mainly of the company's affiliates engaging in real estate leasing, management and sales, passenger ship operations, wholesale of marine machinery and equipment, other transport-related services, information processing services, and wholesale of petroleum products. Major affiliates include Yusen Shoji Co., Ltd., NYK BUSINESS SYSTEMS Co., Ltd., Yusen Shoji Marine Co., Ltd., and Yusen Cruise Co., Ltd. Because it is printed in the filing as one of the reportable segments, it is listed in order of revenue, like the other segments. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥101,954 million (¥114,650 million in the previous year), the sixth largest of the seven reportable segments. Number of employees was 1,885 as of March 31, 2026.
entries.120f89eca5837235: A company that carries out marine transport by container ships, car carriers, tankers, LNG carriers and other vessels, and logistics such as warehousing and freight forwarding, around the world.
entries.14e22b9642c1d7b6: This is transport by large LPG tankers. Market conditions for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were higher than the prior year. Changes in trade patterns caused by tariff policies and other factors, together with heightened tensions in the Middle East that effectively halted LPG exports from the region, increased long-haul shipments and tightened vessel supply and demand.
entries.1896c2fc40bea544: This is one of the categories of the logistics business, handling logistics for major customers. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, handled volume for major customers declined due to uncertainty in the economic outlook caused by the effects of tariff policies and other factors. In fiscal 2025, it acquired a healthcare logistics business in Europe.
entries.1f46f3c739d2bf25: These are ships carrying LNG (liquefied natural gas). For the fiscal year ended March 2026, performance was steady, supported by medium- to long-term contracts that generate stable earnings. As of March 31, 2026, the LNG carriers comprised 14 owned, 4 jointly owned and 3 chartered vessels.
entries.2d7a6f49df8f4fd5: This business handles logistics for automobiles. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, handled volume of operations in Europe and parts of Southeast Asia increased compared with the prior year.
entries.4cb1120815475cab: This business conducts international sea freight transport using dry bulk carriers and others, ship leasing and other shipping operations, and earns freight, charter hire and ship management commissions. It operates Capesize, Panamax and Handysize bulk carriers, as well as chip carriers and conventional and project cargo ships, using owned, jointly owned and chartered vessels. Its main affiliates include NYK Bulk & Project Co., Ltd., Asahi Shipping Co., Ltd., Mitsubishi Ore Transport Co., Ltd., Yasuma Kisen Co., Ltd., Taiheiyo Kisen Co., Ltd. and NS United Kaiun Kaisha, Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥543,152 million (¥601,322 million in the prior year), the second-largest of the 7 reportable segments. Market conditions for each vessel type were higher than in the prior year, and the yen moved stronger compared with the prior year. The number of employees is 618 (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.54837065f73227d4: Sea freight transport by bulk carriers (Capesize, Panamax and Handysize)
entries.56e3b77eeca80d1f: This business relates to port terminals. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, handling volume at domestic terminals declined from the previous year.
entries.5bbbeda990c16fb3: Wholesale of Marine Machinery and Equipment
entries.617aa2ec5adf1a0b: This business conducts international sea freight transport using car carriers and others, automotive logistics and other shipping operations, and earns freight, charter hire and terminal usage fees. As of March 31, 2026, the car carriers comprised 56 owned vessels and 67 chartered vessels. Its main affiliates are INTERNATIONAL CAR OPERATORS N.V., NYK INDIA PVT. LTD., NYK TDG PHILIPPINES INC. and UNITED EUROPEAN CAR CARRIERS B.V. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥526,130 million (¥531,867 million in the prior year), the third-largest of the 7 reportable segments. The number of employees is 1,705 (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.6c97defaed101efb: This business relates to ships and technology and includes the fuel oil sales business. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the fuel oil sales business was sluggish, reflecting lower fuel oil prices and a decline in sales volume.
entries.7193b23361e08e75: Air Transport Business (until the share exchange on August 1, 2025)
entries.872371e3d17fc033: This business operates cruises on the passenger ships Asuka II and Asuka III. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, both Asuka II and Asuka III operated cruises smoothly. It also recorded preparation costs for the entry into service of Asuka III.
entries.8cd02cfcac1ad3bb: This business transports automobiles using car carriers. The number of vehicles transported for the fiscal year ended March 2026 remained at the prior-year level. The yen moved stronger against the prior year.
entries.8f5d5a62c25ca1a9: This is transport by large crude oil tankers. Market conditions for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were higher than the prior year, reflecting increased cargo demand in the Atlantic region and the effects of the de facto closure of the Strait of Hormuz due to heightened tensions in the Middle East.
entries.a7c8b0b423cc42b5: This is one of the categories of the logistics business, handling air cargo. Handled volume for the fiscal year ended March 2026 remained broadly at the same level as the prior year.
entries.b6682da570412ab8: This business provides a comprehensive logistics network across sea, land and air, operating warehousing, freight forwarding and coastal cargo shipping on a global basis. Its main affiliates are YUSEN LOGISTICS Co., Ltd., Kinkai Yusen Co., Ltd. and Camellia Line Co., Ltd., as well as the YUSEN LOGISTICS companies in the United States, China, the United Kingdom, the Benelux countries and Thailand. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥801,751 million (¥808,997 million in the prior year), the largest of the 7 reportable segments and equal to about one-third of consolidated revenue of ¥2,423,689 million. The number of employees is 30,395 (as of March 31, 2026), and the majority of the group's 39,830 employees belong to this business.
entries.c5efd916510a8515: This business conducts international sea freight transport using tankers and others, ship leasing and other shipping operations, and earns freight, charter hire and ship management commissions. As of March 31, 2026, the oil tankers comprised 45 owned, 3 jointly owned and 36 chartered vessels, and the LNG carriers comprised 14 owned, 4 jointly owned and 3 chartered vessels. Its main affiliates include NYK ENERGY OCEAN Co., Ltd., NYK BULKSHIP (ASIA) PTE. LTD., NORTHERN OFFSHORE GROUP AB, Kyoei Tanker Co., Ltd. and KNUTSEN NYK OFFSHORE TANKERS AS. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 increased to ¥236,443 million (¥178,225 million in the prior year), the fourth-largest of the 7 reportable segments. The number of employees is 1,149 (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.e50163f09f199f5d: FPSO (floating production, storage and offloading facility for offshore oil and gas) and shuttle tankers
entries.ed2fa801791c25d9: This business engages in ocean freight shipping, ship leasing, shipping agency, container terminal operation, port transport and tugboat operation, and receives freight, charter fees, container-related income and other revenue. As of March 31, 2026, the container ships comprised 24 owned vessels and 24 chartered vessels. OCEAN NETWORK EXPRESS PTE. LTD. (ONE), a joint venture established in July 2017 by Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha, Ltd. and Mitsui O.S.K. Lines, Ltd. to integrate their regular container shipping businesses, is an equity-method affiliate and is listed as a major related company of this business. Other companies include Yunietsukusu NCT, Yusen Kōun Co., Ltd., Nihon Konteina Yusō Co., Ltd., and Uchiumi Esen Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥174,639 million (¥174,412 million in the previous year), the fifth largest of the seven reportable segments. Number of employees was 3,593 as of March 31, 2026.
entries.efd2d9c6a62b4acc: It is ocean cargo transport by container ships. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, freight rates were volatile and fell below the previous year's level, affected by tariff policies and conditions in the Middle East and other factors, in addition to an increase in vessel supply from the delivery of newbuild ships. Freight rates also declined at ONE, an equity-method affiliate.
entries.f0e59d9876f3a919: These are tankers carrying oil products. Market conditions for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were higher than the prior year, as rising crude oil prices caused by heightened tensions in the Middle East spread through the market.
entries.fe9266bda9ed1e66: This business handles FPSOs (floating production, storage and offloading facilities for offshore oil and gas) and shuttle tankers. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, operation of a new FPSO began. Existing FPSOs and shuttle tankers performed steadily.
entries.ff56edcd1e9eafc1: This reportable segment, engaged in the air transport business, was carried by Nippon Cargo Airlines Co., Ltd. (NCA), which had been a consolidated subsidiary. On August 1, 2025, all shares of Nippon Cargo Airlines Co., Ltd. were transferred to ANA Holdings Inc. in a share exchange, so NCA is not included in results from the second quarter of the fiscal year ended March 2026 onward. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥39,616 million (¥179,225 million in the previous year), the smallest of the seven reportable segments. Through the share exchange, the company acquired 3,926,000 shares of ANA Holdings Inc., which it holds to continue its involvement in the air cargo transport business. This business is not listed in the employee count breakdown as of March 31, 2026. Aircraft are also excluded from the principal facilities.
